in_marathi.name: Kumod
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Rays of the moon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kumod हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kumod is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kumuda', meaning 'rays of the moon'. In Hindu mythology, the moon is often associated with prosperity, peace, and tranquility. The name Kumod is believed to bring these qualities to the one who bears it.
